confirmActionMessage: Are you sure you want to {{action}} {{name}}? This action may cause data loss.
vmidWarning: VMID {{id}} may already be in use
haStoppedMigrateTitle: This guest is stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBody: Proxmox hands the move to the HA manager, which migrates a stopped guest offline later. If it cannot, the guest stays on {{node}} and only the HA log on that node says why, and the job ends as not moved. To move it now, start it and migrate it live.
haStoppedMigrateBulkTitle_one: {{count}} selected guest is stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBulkTitle_other: {{count}} selected guests are stopped and HA-managed
haStoppedMigrateBulkBody: {{names}}. Proxmox hands each move to the HA manager, which migrates a stopped guest offline later. If it cannot, the guest stays where it is and only the HA log on its node says why, and its job ends as not moved. To move them now, start them and migrate them live.
destroyDesc: This will permanently destroy {{name}} and all its data. This action cannot be undone.
cloudInitNotDetected: No cloud-init drive detected. Add a cloud-init drive (IDE, SCSI, etc.) to this VM to configure cloud-init settings.
noScheduledTasks: No scheduled tasks for this resource.
